'''2012 SoCal Grand Prix Anthony Howard DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Anthony Howard]] at [[2012 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Grand Prix).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Grand Prix
